<!-- BEGIN:nextjs-agent-rules -->

# This is NOT the Next.js you know

This version has breaking changes — APIs, conventions, and file structure may all differ from your training data. Read the relevant guide in `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` (resolved from this file's directory; in monorepos the `next` package may not be visible from the repo root) before writing any code. Heed deprecation notices.

This block is written and re-added by `next dev` — verify at `node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/generate-agent-files.js`. Removing it from a diff only re-creates the uncommitted change; committing it with your work keeps the tree clean.

<!-- END:nextjs-agent-rules -->

package.json.content:
{
  "name": "nextron",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "author": "Nextron Team <team@example.com>",
  "license": "MIT",
  "description": "Production Desktop Application built with Next.js 16 and Electron",
  "main": "electron/main.js",
  "scripts": {
    "sync:config": "node scripts/sync-config.mjs",
    "build:electron": "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json",
    "watch:electron": "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch",
    "dev": "node scripts/sync-config.mjs && concurrently -k \"next dev --webpack\" \"tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch\" \"wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3000 && electron .\"",
    "dev:web": "node scripts/sync-config.mjs && next dev --webpack",
    "build": "node scripts/sync-config.mjs && npm run build:electron && next build",
    "postbuild": "node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs",
    "init:app": "npm run build:electron && electron . --init",
    "init:cli": "node scripts/init-cli.mjs",
    "creator": "npm run init:app",
    "start": "next start",
    "clean": "node -e \"const fs = require('fs'); ['out', '.next'].forEach(p => { try { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch {} }); console.log('Clean complete');\"",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "lint:fix": "eslint . --fix",
    "prepackage": "node scripts/sync-config.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run lint",
    "package": "npm run prepackage && npm run build && electron-forge package",
    "make": "npm run prepackage && npm run build && electron-forge make",
    "publish": "npm run prepackage && npm run build && electron-forge publish"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@radix-ui/react-slot": "^1.3.3",
    "@tailwindcss/postcss": "^4.3.3",
    "class-variance-authority": "^0.7.1",
    "clsx": "^2.1.1",
    "electron-squirrel-startup": "^1.0.1",
    "lucide-react": "^1.46.0",
    "next": "^16.0.0",
    "react": "^19.0.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.0.0",
    "tailwind-merge": "^3.7.0",
    "tailwindcss": "^4.3.3"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@electron-forge/cli": "^7.8.3",
    "@electron-forge/maker-deb": "^7.8.3",
    "@electron-forge/maker-dmg": "^7.8.3",
    "@electron-forge/maker-squirrel": "^7.8.3",
    "@electron-forge/maker-zip": "^7.8.3",
    "@types/node": "^22.10.2",
    "@types/react": "^19.0.2",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.0.2",
    "concurrently": "^9.1.0",
    "electron": "^37.2.0",
    "eslint": "^9.18.0",
    "eslint-config-next": "^16.0.0",
    "typescript": "^5.7.2",
    "wait-on": "^8.0.1"
  },
  "allowScripts": {
    "electron@37.10.3": true,
    "electron-winstaller@5.4.4": true,
    "unrs-resolver@1.12.2": true
  }
}

tsconfig.electron.json.content:
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "CommonJS",
    "moduleResolution": "node",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "outDir": "electron",
    "rootDir": "electron",
    "strict": true,
    "noEmit": false,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "sourceMap": true,
    "declaration": false,
    "allowJs": false
  },
  "include": ["electron/**/*.ts"],
  "exclude": ["electron/types.d.ts", "node_modules"]
}
